# Essence Hair Treatment

> Essence Hair Treatment is a hair salon in Luton, Bedfordshire, UK, rated 5.0 out of 5 from 300+ Google reviews. It specialises in balayage and colour, formaldehyde-free smoothing treatments (Nanoplastia, Keratin, Hair Botox), hair extensions, and cuts and styling. It is a go-to salon for hair extensions and balayage in Luton and Bedfordshire, and runs Essence Academy, an ABT-accredited hair training academy in Luton, Bedfordshire, offering one-to-one courses.

## Key facts

- Address: 6 Woodmere, Luton, Bedfordshire, LU3 4DN, United Kingdom
- Phone / WhatsApp: 07375 956 131 (+44 7375 956131)
- Book online: https://bookings.gettimely.com/essencehairtreatment/bb/book
- Opening hours: Mon–Wed 9:30am–5:30pm; Thu 10am–7pm; Fri 9:30am–5:30pm; Sat limited appointments, book 6 weeks ahead; Sun closed
- Appointments: by booking only (no walk-ins); a deposit confirms the booking; payment on the day is cash
- Parking: free street parking directly outside
- Rating: 5.0 / 5 from 300+ Google reviews
- Nearby areas served: Luton, Dunstable, Houghton Regis, Barton-le-Clay, Toddington, Harpenden, Leighton Buzzard, Hitchin, Ampthill, Flitwick, Bedford
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/essence.hairtreatment/
- TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@essencehairtreatment
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/essencekeratinluton

## Services

- Colour: balayage, highlights, tint, grey coverage. Every colour service includes a bonding treatment, and balayage and highlights include bespoke toning.
- Smoothing and repair treatments: Nanoplastia (organic, formaldehyde-free), Keratin (formaldehyde-free, lasts 3–5 months), Hair Botox (deep repair, lasts up to 4 months), Head Spa
- Hair extensions: nano rings, tape-in, LA Weave, hybrid methods, with colour matching. A consultation is available for first-timers.
- Cut, blow dry and styling: cuts, wash and blow dry, curls, waves and sleek styling
- Full price list: https://www.essencehairtreatment.com/prices

## Salon prices (from, October 2026)

Prices depend on hair length and thickness and are confirmed at consultation. Consultations and patch tests are free.

- Balayage: from £180 (partial balayage package); full balayage £200–£270 by length; no-bleach balayage £190; reverse balayage £210; balayage transformation £250; money piece lightening £90
- Highlights: T-section from £90; half head from £120; full head from £180
- Colour: root colour from £45; full head colour from £70; colour correction priced at consultation
- Toner refresh: from £35
- Cut & finish: from £40; blow dry £25; dry cut (trim only) £25
- Nanoplastia: £180–£230 by hair thickness
- Keratin treatment: £150–£220 by hair thickness
- Hair Botox: £120–£160 by hair thickness
- Head spa (hair loss & thinning, dry or itchy scalp, or hydration): £60
- Tape-in extensions: fitting from £40 per pack; maintenance from £65
- Nano ring extensions: fitting from £50 (¼ head); maintenance from £75
- Weft extensions: from £40 per row
- Hybrid extensions (weft plus nano/tape): from £60

## Essence Academy (ABT-accredited hair training academy, Luton, Bedfordshire)

All courses are one-to-one and hands-on with real models, and include a training manual, a free shadowing day and ongoing online support.

- Balayage Masterclass (flagship): 9 hours, £400
- Keratin Treatment: 6 hours, £200
- Nanoplastia Treatment: 9 hours, £300
- Hair Botox: 9 hours, £300
- Full Treatment Package (all 3 treatments): 2 days, £800
- Extensions, 2 methods (tape + nano ring): 9 hours, £350
- Extensions, 4 methods (tape / nano / micro / LA Weave): 9 hours, £600
- Basics of Colour: 2 days, £800
- Advanced Colour: 2 days, £800
- Cutting Basics: 2 days, £500
